position: Adapter pattern only; static site remains stable
headline: VedaPath now has a safe bridge from UI to local backend.
copy: The adapter proves how the frontend can ask a local source server without breaking GitHub Pages or hiding the boundary when the server is absent.

postures.title: Request builder
postures.copy: Builds a /source?question=... URL from a local API base.

postures.title: Timeout
postures.copy: Fails quickly so the interface does not feel stuck.

postures.title: Fallback packet
postures.copy: Returns source_found false with a clear local-server-unavailable reason.

postures.title: Static site
postures.copy: No page depends on the local API to render.

postures.title: Production
postures.copy: No hosted endpoint or secret-bearing integration exists.

flow.title: Detect
flow.copy: Only call the local API when a base URL is supplied.

flow.title: Ask
flow.copy: Fetch one source packet with a short timeout.

flow.title: Fallback
flow.copy: Show unavailable state instead of inventing a source.

decisions.label: Default base
decisions.reason: Useful for private demos, not public web use.

decisions.label: Timeout
decisions.reason: Fast enough for UI confidence without masking a missing server.

decisions.label: Fallback
decisions.reason: The UI should never fabricate retrieval.

decisions.label: Integration
decisions.reason: The adapter is present but not wired as a dependency.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled by this release.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed source text delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: The adapter is not a remote API client, account layer, telemetry pipe, or launch integration.

packet:
